findings: Registration UI/sample terminal is not actual readiness; runner application must be active.
Force removal without host access cannot prove local configurations/services cleaned.
ARC does not support the default self-hosted label; label recommendation must remain scoped.
Deleting local .runner permits re-registration but does not prove old remote registration removed or host sanitized.
scope: Twenty full fragments. Source credential-shaped literal not copied; no command execution, token generation, installation, deletion or native change. Independent audits, raster/rendered review, rights and adoption remain separate.
